newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: ICTSI says sets 50 percent stock payout.
newsitem.headline: ICTSI says sets 50 percent stock payout.

text.p: Port operator International Container Terminal Services Inc declared on Monday a 50 percent stock dividend, the Philippine Stock Exchange said in a notice to brokers.
The exchange said ICTSI has yet to announce the record date for shareholders entitled to the stock dividend.
In March 1996, ICTSI also issued a 50 percent stock payout.
ICTSI declared a 25 percent stock dividend in 1995, 30 percent in 1994 and 20 percent each in 1993 and 1992.
The firm is the operator of the Manila International Container Terminal which handles 70 percent of container traffic in the country.
ICTSI also has interests in port management in Aden, Argentina, Mexico, Pakistan and China.
